Abilities

Gain two of these Yellow abilities, each using a different power:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.Lii30GC1FebaBCDB]{Area Healing}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.1piVWzovN4gSyeow]{Mass Modification}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.6zwCcOJUDztqv9Bv]{Personal Upgrade}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.aFEydFX484OarPfB]{Reach through Veil}
Additional Info

Gain one power not on the above list. Assign it a d10.

Archetype

Roll d10, d10, d6 for archetype selection.
